name: Poisson on a cylinder, tensor splines, preconditioner StiffnessPreconditioner
description:
Poisson equation on a cylinder of radius 1 and length 4, comparing C1 polar splines
(IGAPolarCylinder, no hole) with tensor-product splines on a cylinder with a hole (HollowCylinder, a1=1e-2).
The manufactured solution is a Gaussian whose gradient is largest on the axis r=0.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set at r=1 (boundary condition free at the hole).
The linear system is solved with CG, preconditioner StiffnessPreconditioner (poloidal solver schur).

fun.name: rhs_fun
fun.source:

    return rhs_lam(x, y, z) + 0.0 * x
